## History

Small Anne Cordelia was born to [Diana Wright](../character/diana-barry.md), who named her after her close friend [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). While holding her young child in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) garret, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) conversed with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) concluding her teaching career and her plans to marry [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016)_
